correctness.rationale: For each d>=1, two independent symmetric Dirichlet(alpha) barycentric vectors are normalized independent gamma coordinates. Hilbert distance with full log cross-ratio is the range of d+1 iid log ratios Gamma(alpha)/Gamma(alpha), since common normalization cancels. The ratios have even strictly log-concave generalized-logistic density and characteristic product prod_k(1+t^2/(alpha+k)^2)^(-1). For alpha<beta the quotient factors as independent Bernoulli-Laplace increments with variance sum finite, so the alpha coordinate vector has beta vector plus independent nonconstant symmetric coordinate noise. Prekopa log-concavity and symmetry bound the probability of the convex centrally symmetric range <=r event; strictness follows because any nonconstant translation has analytic nonconstant probability tending to zero at infinity, and the noise is nonconstant with positive probability. This proves strict all-threshold stochastic ordering with appropriate normalization. The exact CDF, alpha=1 logistic E D=2H_d, alpha->0 and infinity limits follow. Independent characteristic-factor comparisons at six triples and nine m/threshold CDF grids agreed. Finite tests are corroboration only.
